# 首页开放校园封面 v1

2026-10-23，按用户要求使用内置 `image_gen` 生成校园入口封面；不是运行时3D截图。网页明确标注“校园概念封面”，点击后进入真实 Three.js 校园。

源图保存：`campus-courtyard-cover-source-v1.png`。网站使用1600×900 WebP（259848字节）和800×450移动 WebP（80512字节），由 sharp 仅等比缩放和编码；没有把源PNG用于网页请求。原始生成文件另存于 Codex generated_images，项目引用均在本目录，移交后无需访问 C 盘。

## 最终生成提示词

Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: a wide photographic architectural cover for the homepage entrance to a real 3D Chinese university campus. Create a new landscape image, approximately 16:9. Scene: a contemporary Chinese university courtyard, four-storey U-shaped academic building at the back with dark grey brick, cream limestone structural frames, blue-grey standing-seam hipped roofs, large clear windows; a lower elegant library at the left; a small open bronze-and-timber social pavilion at the right; broad warm-white stone pedestrian paving; one refined low circular fountain slightly right of centre with restrained water jets and a bronze nozzle. A few carefully spaced mature trees with clustered crowns, low tidy shrubs, timber benches and planted lawn islands; mostly open walkable paved space. Modern Chinese campus proportions, restrained light academic architecture, built and believable. Camera at slightly elevated 8-metre height from the courtyard entrance, looking toward the academic building; strong architectural depth but natural 35mm lens perspective, straight verticals. Photoreal architectural visualization, premium actual-built campus photography, physically plausible PBR stone, glass, metal and wood, warm gentle late-afternoon natural light, soft long shadows, natural balanced greens and blue sky. Readable clean building massing. Main architectural subject across centre and upper two thirds; keep bottom-left foreground visually calm for separately coded website headline. Elegant and inviting, high-quality architectural editorial photography. No humans, no characters, no illustration, no anime, no game markers, no maps, no UI, no text, no letters, no digits, no logos, no watermark, no medieval castle or gothic towers, no tropical palms, no oversaturation, no excessive trees. This is an entrance cover image only, not a screenshot of the running application.
